values.goal: Author the complete ten-article ADL launch series as source-grounded, review-ready publication packets.
values.required_outcome: Ten complete articles, each with a bounded source packet and editorial review, form a coherent series whose claims, citations, links, privacy posture, and release dependencies are explicit.
authority_boundary: WP-24 owns the ten review-ready article packets
danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5819 supplies canonical naming and link inputs
operator_constraints: All ten articles must be complete prose, not outlines or topic cards
Drafting depends on danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5819 and final release claims depend on danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5843
No invented citation, metric, customer claim, or delivery claim
No publication or scheduling without separate operator authority
Release the preparation claim before implementation handoff
